title: Underlying mixed tensor homology with scalar and generator naturality
statement: Let R be a commutative ring in universe u, i an integer, and F any cochain complex of R-modules. Let T be the ordinary total tensor bifunctor of R-complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There is a family of additive equivalences e(A,Q): H^i(T(restrict_R(Q),F)) to H^i(mixedTotalTensor(R to A)(Q,F)), for every commutative R-algebra A in universe u and every A-module complex Q [def-pc-mixed-total-tensor; def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology]. The family intertwines T(restrict_R(a times identity_Q),F) with multiplication by a on mixed homology. Let Aq be another commutative R-algebra with an A-algebra structure and compatible R to A to Aq tower, let Qq be an Aq-complex, g:restrict_R(Q) to restrict_R(Qq) an R-chain map, and v:mixed(Q,F) to restrict_A(mixed(Qq,F)) an A-chain map. Suppose v sends each diagonal generator inclusion(x tensor_A (1 tensor_R y)) to inclusion(g(x) tensor_Aq (1 tensor_R y)). Then the inverse exact-restriction homology comparison sends e(Aq,Qq)(H^i(T(g,F))(x)) to H^i(v)(e(A,Q)(x)). No K-flatness, quasi-isomorphism or derived category hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Use Mathlib TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange to identify restriction of M tensor_A (A tensor_R N) with restriction(M) tensor_R N. Nested tensor induction proves naturality in the module variables. Form the corresponding bicomplex isomorphism. HomologicalComplex2.mapTotalIso and total.mapIso give the total chain isomorphism with the same factor order and signs. Its summand formula follows from map_ι_mapTotalXIso_inv and ιTotal_map; cancelBaseChange_tmul gives the pure-tensor equation.

Forget to additive groups. Restriction and forgetting preserve coproducts. Their total comparison and coproduct extensionality show that a map out of the total is determined by diagonal summands. Nested tensor induction reduces every summand to x tensor (1 tensor y), using x tensor (a tensor y)=(a x) tensor (1 tensor y). Thus the generator hypothesis proves naturality of the underlying additive chain isomorphism for g and v.

Apply homology to the inverse chain isomorphism and compose the exact-forgetful homology comparisons, obtaining the actual family homComp. Prove compatibility of iterated exact-functor homology comparisons from the same left homology data, cancelling the intermediate comparison. ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso naturality then proves the requested v equation. Multiplication by a gives the analogous chain equation by summand extensionality; ShortComplex.homologyMap_smul gives multiplication by a on homology. Package the two identities with homComp.
